decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems sits squarely in the firm's established hearing-system fitting expertise, and its in-house R&D and digital production know-how let it interpret early results and refine the product. Its thin web presence (only a mention) adds slight uncertainty.

The EARsleeve custom in-ear earmold has its own page and builds directly on the firm's core earmold manufacturing knowledge. Strong absorptive capacity from in-house R&D and labs makes continued improvement and retention likely.

A vacuum thermoforming unit is closely related to the firm's long-standing dental equipment and materials business. With its own page and in-house R&D supporting it, the firm can readily assimilate feedback, so it will likely keep the product.
